name: lw-watchtower
description: WINDOWS ONLY. Requires Windows PowerShell 5.1: all fifteen hook registrations invoke a binary literally named powershell, which is not pwsh and does not exist on macOS or Linux. A Claude Code governance layer that refuses to overstate itself. Ten modules in total: seven modules OBSERVE and block nothing - the effort ledger, one switch over one data source, which records tool, hook and subagent failures, appends the dispatch record, reconciles subagent transcripts against their stop records to catch an agent killed mid-flight, and since 6 September 2026 carries a transition ladder that warns the model before a context or rate-limit wall and names a handoff skill, end-of-turn advisories for unverified work, docs coupling and git hygiene, self-health, log rotation, a session banner and status line, per-dispatch context injection for subagents, and one working discipline per session pointed at the vendored ruleset for it, WHICH SHIPS SWITCHED OFF because it has never run in a live session and is a second interpreter process on every subagent dispatch - and THREE are gates that can refuse or hold an action: delegate_gate, a PreToolUse hook that blocks Edit, Write, NotebookEdit, Bash and PowerShell on the main thread so all work goes to subagents; send_liveness_gate, which refuses a message to a subagent it can prove is dead mid-flight; and completion_audit, which refuses to let a turn end that claims completed work whose last action was a queued send. ALL THREE SHIP SWITCHED OFF, and so does stack_mode, so as installed nothing here blocks, denies or delays a tool call. The destructive-command and secret-scanning gates were removed on 30 July 2026 at the owner's instruction and are not coming back: nothing here inspects a shell command, a path or a credential, and setup installs no permissions.deny rules.
